title: Lax-idempotent monad
description: JSON Schema for a lax-idempotent monad (KZ-monad) — a 2-monad whose multiplication μ is left adjoint to the unit-precomposition T(η) (Kock 1995; Zöberlein 1976). KZ-monads generalize idempotent monads and characterize 'free completion' constructions. The closure-2-monad referenced in the legacy 561 corpus is a KZ-monad. Specializes monad by adding the unit-multiplication-adjunction-witness cell.

unit-multiplication-adjunction-witness.description: Reference to the adjunction instance witnessing μ ⊣ T(η) — the lax-idempotent condition. Names the adjunction that makes this monad KZ.
